chapter_keywords: A Record of a Mortal’s Journey to Immortality
chapter_seo_title: RMJI Chapter 65: Han Li Secures Divine Hand Valley as a Medical Master
chapter_meta_description: Han Li forges a letter to inherit Doctor Mo’s position as a physician, using his secret vial’s herbs to build a reputation as a miracle healer in the Seven Mysteries Sect.
og_description: Half a year after the possession crisis, Han Li secures his power base by faking a letter, impressing the sect elders, and becoming the Seven Mysteries Sect’s most famous healer.
twitter_description: With a forged letter and premium herbs, Han Li takes over Doctor Mo’s medical role—but his real prize is the privacy to use his secret bottle.
